notes.title: Update notes for December 23rd
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Bug fixes related to hotkeys logic, allowing infinite outputs to be placed.
- Finally fixed the file system integration, allowing to save local scores to a local file. For security and privacy reasons we do not save user's scores in our database but we do save local scores to keep track of the high scores.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1st of December
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Connected all wires to allow the game to support modes.
- Added Hardcore mode (no pause allowed!)
- We have some other modes in mind like prestige and infinite modes that will substantially change the game, but we first need to test the adoption of the new features

[h2]Notes[/h2]

I know, this is a really small update, we are trying to get the game back on Linux but it has been quite annoyingly hard due to the native of the bug/error. We are still putting our efforts there but we hope to have a solution soon.

Thank you so much for all the feedback you sent, its always welcomed !

notes.title: Small Update Notes for November 1 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- fixed render bug with water
- balanced Warzone map and Frozen Forest map. Shield and firecamp tiles can be found there too.
- fixed proximity mine effect to avoid counting the output and itself. Only surrounding tiles are evaluated.

[h2]Notes[/h2]

Small updates today, quick patch after initial feedback!
Loved seeing the new basketball tile in daily map challenges.

Thank you all

notes.title: Update notes for October 31 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hotkey support: hover the tile you want, press a 1-10 key and that will be the key for that tile.
[*] Tile interface rework to avoid the need of scrolling.
[*] 3 new base maps, with 2 different new features or (traps). We want to expose these new features to see how the adoption goes before creating more seasonal versions.
[*] 4 new tiles: basketball, distributor, sponsor and shield.
[*] Tile skins: From the Tile Gallery menu, when exploring a tile, a skin can be selected. Currently we just have a basic darker one and we are exploring the adoption of the community to these skins.
[*] Changed the way tiles get unlocked. Now new tiles just get unlocked upon finishing games. Some tiles are still locked under the puzzles. Tiles that previously were unlocked on seasonal maps now can get unlocked by just playing the game. This is because many people didn't find out that there were tiles to unlock and we want people to know that :)
[*] 2 different performance fixes related to rendering were pushed. These 2 fixes are tied to internal logic. Nothing else to mention but we hope the game runs better overall now.
[*] Minor translation fixes.
[*] Added missing shortcut explanations in the overview menu.
[*] Added "S" shortcut to hide all tiles and display tile bonuses only.
[*] Added drills to Mystery Space 02.
[*] Updated how belts are created, making it easier to connect tiles to target tiles. Its still not perfect but it may help a lot when connecting jumpers.
[*] Updated belt's design. It will look better now.
[*] Added the Portal theme to the bundle of possible themes.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]

It has been a while, a lot of little fixes and some bigger features were developed. We are exploring also the idea of having "hats" and some sort of cosmetics into the game. But also exploring the idea of having them do something special and be a new resource to make the gameplay even deeper.

I might have forgotten important updates in the list above, it has been a while !

Big thanks to RCE for showcasing the game this week !

[previewyoutube=nMlsDwEaIso;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 16 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Fixed text explanation for coffee
- Fixed small typos on several descriptions
- Cleaned up builds and files from previous tries to fix the linux builds (this took some time)
- Introduced Maps Categories to clarify the purpose of each map
- Introduced Monthly Challenges as a way of having a longer challenge map that also renews over time. These maps offer a mix of the new tiles and sometimes will contain secret tiles so they can be unlocked there as well.

[h2]Notes[/h2]

Thank you all for the support of the last days, the reviews helped a ton! 
We are going to keep updating the game and working with the lovely community on the discord server.

Thanks also to Olexa for bringing yet another amazing gameplay featuring the new soundtrack of the game!

[previewyoutube=BZy2c1Nw7E8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 31 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Coffee was rebalanced due to a really high value in early game
- Portal bugs were fixed where sending money to many portals resulted in less money being output
- Achievement progress for some tiles were fixed

[h2]Notes[/h2]

I keep investigating the Linux build issues. In this delivery I'm sending AppImage and also a plain executable. Some people can get it working and some people don't, myself included as I configured a Linux machine to debug this.
I managed to get it working uncompressing the AppImage and then executing the executable manually, but when I bind it to steam it doesn't work.
I'll keep you guys updated.

Thanks for the support as always and my renewed apologies to Linux and steam deck users. A ticket was opened with Steam support to understand what happened as the game worked until a certain update on the steam's side.

As a super small note, I started digging into the idea of the new renderer for the game. At this point I may start making a small prototype of what it could look like but I want to fix the linux issue first if possible.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 23rd
notes.content:
[h2]Big Updates[/h2]

- New Music theme! An [b]exclusive[/b] extended version of "The Atrium" by [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/0Tqf9Yj15NqruGjhlKa6yb?autoplay=true]Mystery Mammal[/url]
- Steam achievements integration. All stats get migrated automatically to steam. New achievements will come in the next updates.
- 4 new maps to unlock new tiles
- 7 new tiles to shake things up a little. But be careful, not all are friendly!
- 8 new color themes for daily and nightly maps as well as for future puzzle maps

[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Music pace increases or decreases with the play speed
- removed 1-2 key binds for speed, now its a toggle with the letter F. This is to allow factory key binds in the future updates
- Reduced $ bonus duration to 5 seconds, 20 seconds was too much and made the game a bit unpredictable.
- Pressing A key will display much more production information as well as an average production for the last 10 cycles and 20 cycles.

[h2]New tiles[/h2]

- New Tile Drill
- New Tile Heart
- New Tile Timebomb
- New Tile Underclocker
- New Tile Coffee
- New Tile Missile
- New Tile Upgrader

[h2]Bugs and Improvements[/h2]

- Fixed firecamp displaying incorrect numbers
- Fixed sound issues when transitioning between screens in some cases.
- Resolved a performance issue that may cause the game to run faster now. Still need to work on a renderer but this should help. I'll keep investigating if there are other ways to improve performance until the new renderer is sorted.

[h2]Notes[/h2]

Can't thank enough the community for the messages, discussions, questions, ideas, contributions and help. Special thanks for Linkchu_Markus for the incredible bulls eye to find bugs and strategies to break the game in really fancy ways.

If everything goes okay with this big update, future updates and puzzles will come in a better way. I used this time to craft a small level editor to help with the puzzle creation but its on the agenda to add more features and maps.

I'm sure I'm forgetting to mention half of the things in this update, this last week was intense!
I hope you like the new content!

notes.title: Update Notes for July 11 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Being able to press "[b]ESC[/b]" to go back in menus
- Add [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] Language
- Music and SFX volume pickers (when hovering volume button)
- Added "[b]W[/b]" keybinding to Upgrade buildings.
- Upgrade Description Improvements. Removed all (+2) confusing notation.
- Display all production information when pressing "[b]A[/b]" hotkey
- BugFix: Display Upgrade data even if we can’t afford it
- Display the entire list of upgrade details. All upgrade levels can be seen from the [b]+[/b] button on the inspector. Or by holding "[b]A[/b]" pressed.
- Speed controls were moved from keys "[b]1[/b]" and "[b]2[/b]" to "[b]F[/b]". Speed is increased while holding "F". I'm thinking it could also be a finite resource to control. This was done in favor of future features like custom hotkey-keybindings to place tiles faster.

[h3]Notes[/h3]

Thank you all for the support and the long list of improvement/ideas/feedback. I made and shared a doc with all the tasks so anyone can check what's coming next. You can get access via discord.

[b]Hope you enjoy the game, new content is coming as soon as the urgent feedback is solved.[/b]

notes.title: Update Notes for July 8 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Improved visibility on how to connect tiles. Specially the Jumper.
- Improved how upgrades are displayed.
- Removed the toggle for coin stacks, and added a help button with all the shortcuts.

[h2]Next Release Goals[/h2]

- New Tiles

[h3]Side Notes[/h3]

I had to focus on these urgent updates so the game becomes clearer to new players.
We have around 6 new tiles in mind. I invite everyone to share their ideas too.
Thank you for your support as always.

Orbital Potato featured a Coin Factory Gameplay that is totally worth checking out

notes.content:

- Removed extra links under the settings menu.
- Added better full screen support by allowing different ways of toggling full screen:

[list]
[*] ALT + ENTER
[*] ALT + SPACE
[*] F11
[*] CTRL + F 
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for July 5 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

- Fixed performance issues related to Overclocker + Investor
- Added 2 more maps: Huge and Aperture
- Renamed Aperture to Aperture 2
- Now tiles get unlocked and remain unlocked if they are used at least one time. This allows to mix secret tiles and use them in non daily maps. It also allows for new tiles and strategies to be added
- Added visual effects
- Added new Shortcut "U" to upgrade tiles on click
- Added buttons on the top navigation to control some of the new features
- Fixed issues with Double Click not working properly
- Added Zoom-in Zoom-out with mouse wheel

[h2]Existing shortcuts[/h2]

D - delete
U - update
Double Click - update
SPACE - pause
1 - normal speed
2 - fast speed
I - isometric toggle
N - next song
M - mute
C - coins toggle

[h2]Extra notes[/h2]

Performance fixes, the new zoom feature and the new menu rework allowed the Huge map to be added. It could work laggy in some scenarios. Future plans to work on a better renderer are in place.
